none: PAS NLM-8BD8B5: Roman Coin: Copy Denarius imitating issue of Septimius Severus, from North Ormsby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy with silver wash. Coin. Copy Denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), possibly imitating issue of AD 200. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: SEVERVS AVG[---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with both arms extended over shield. Inscription indistinct. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 2 page 463 no. 6333 for the…
